verdict.rationale: AFK documents goal-driven processes that run as dependency graphs, with steps that resume when dependencies clear and tasks described as running 'on autopilot'. None of the evidence describes a user-configurable recurring schedule, such as cron-style or interval-based jobs. Event- and dependency-triggered one-off execution is a different capability from scheduled recurrence, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
